commandments widget — Tend the widgets — every one of them, in the order they were made, with a summary long enough to wrap past the width.
Also answers to: widgets

Usage:
  commandments widget               the list
  commandments widget add "<title>" --under=<id> [--priority=NUMBER] --and-a-very-long-form
                                    queue one — a subtask when --under names its parent, which
                                    carries its number
  commandments widget show <id>

Options:
  --under=<id>      the parent
  --dry-run[=FILE]  preview a unified diff instead of applying it; with FILE, write the diff there
                    rather than to the terminal

  A widget is a small thing. This note is long enough that it has to wrap onto a second line when
  the screen lays it out at the classic terminal width.

  Short note.
